curation_policy: Only specific evidenced conceptual confusions. Generic listing, missing context, weak development, missing units and one-sided answers stay in examiner findings; they are not invented conceptual confusions.

entries.confusion: Profit maximisation versus merely earning more profit

Most learners failed to use “highest possible profit or as high as possible”, and instead used much or more. The point of the difference between TC and TR could not be given by most learners. Describe what is meant by profit maximisation. • When firms make the highest profits possible (1) • Profit maximisation is achieved where MC = MR (1) • The change in cost resulting from producing one extra unit of output is equal to the change
source_evidence.note: This is examiner evidence of a confusion; the distinction and diagnostic are our paraphrase.
